children: The Reserve Bank of India likely intervened in the foreign exchange market on Thursday, four traders told Reuters, as a surge in US Treasury yields and volatile oil prices continued to weigh on the currency.
weakened 0.1% to 95.84 per dollar, averting steeper losses largely on the back of central bank intervention.
Frequent interventions by the RBI have helped contain the currency's fall on the stronger side of 96 per dollar, a key psychological support level for the currency, traders said.
